role: YAML skill package loader and validator for Co-Being knowledge graph installation pipeline
detail: Implements the complete skill package loading workflow: YAML file/content parsing, structural schema validation, and CANON compliance checking via SkillPackageValidator. Primary entry point is load_skill_package(package_source, persistence, installed_packages, is_content) → LoadResult, which returns success flag, validated package_data dict, package_id, version, and any validation_errors. LoadResult is a frozen dataclass capturing success/failure with human-readable error_message. Helper _validate_yaml_structure() enforces required fields (package_id, version, canon_provenance), type-checks structured fields (nodes list, edges list, requires list, cross_domain_bridges list), and validates node/edge dictionary structures before CANON validation. _get_installed_packages() queries the graph persistence layer for existing SkillPackage META_SCHEMA nodes to build installed package set. validate_yaml_string() performs syntax and structural checks without graph access (testing-only). All functions handle exceptions and return results rather than raising.
gotchas: No exceptions raised from load_skill_package(); all errors captured in LoadResult. CANON validation deferred to SkillPackageValidator (external dependency). _get_installed_packages() falls back to empty set on query failure (line 264-265). validate_yaml_string() skips CANON validation and graph checks; returned package_data should not be used for installation. Logging uses structured keys (skill_package_loaded, skill_package_load_failed, queried_installed_packages, failed_to_query_installed_packages).
